entity_model_features.config.parrot_shou: Will automatically make parrot shoulder position follow the animated player position by default, this is not equivalent to the `parrot_left` and `parrot_right` attachment points as these will not rotate.
entity_model_features.config.sulfur_cube: Will automatically make Sulfur Cube internal blocks animate by default, this is equivalent to having a 'sulfur_cube_block' attachment in the model's 'cube' part with offset 0,0,0.
